appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.scannerLayoutHorizontalDescription: Camera on the left, scanned cards on the right
appearance.scannerLayoutVerticalDescription: Camera on top, scanned cards below

dataUsage.heading: Data usage
dataUsage.description: What this app is storing on your disk, and how to reclaim it.
dataUsage.partial: Some of this could not be measured: {{parts}}. The total is lower than the real one.
dataUsage.reusable: {{size}} of dead space the database will reuse

collection.label: Collection
collection.hint: Your saved cards and their images. Never deleted from here.

databaseOverhead.label: Database overhead
databaseOverhead.hint: The write-ahead log, system catalogs, and free space inside the database files.

dialogDescription.scanCaptures: Deletes the saved photo of each scan. The scan's numbers — score, candidates, OCR reading — are kept. This frees real disk space.
dialogDescription.scanDiagnostics: Deletes the record of past identify attempts: scores, candidates, and OCR readings used for tuning accuracy.
dialogDescription.machineTelemetry: Deletes the serial log of commands sent to and from the machine. Used to diagnose jams and disconnects.
dialogDescription.configHistory: Deletes saved snapshots of your bin, module, and feeder settings. These are the restore points behind the Restore buttons — your current settings are not affected.

trim.protectedNote_one: {{count}} reviewed scan is always kept, at every age. Reviewed scans are labelled training data and cannot be regenerated.
trim.protectedNote_other: {{count}} reviewed scans are always kept, at every age. Reviewed scans are labelled training data and cannot be regenerated.
trim.notShrinkNote: Deleted rows free space inside the database file for new data to reuse. The file itself does not shrink.

confirmBounded.scanCaptures: Deletes {{count}} capture images older than the age you picked. The scans themselves are kept.
confirmBounded.scanDiagnostics: Deletes {{count}} scan records older than the age you picked, along with their capture images.
confirmBounded.machineTelemetry: Deletes {{count}} telemetry events older than the age you picked.
confirmBounded.configHistory: Deletes {{count}} config snapshots older than the age you picked. Your current settings are not affected.

confirmAll.scanCaptures: Deletes all {{count}} capture images. The scans keep their numbers but lose their photos. This cannot be undone.
confirmAll.scanDiagnostics: Deletes all {{count}} scan records and their capture images. Reviewed scans are kept. This cannot be undone — diagnostics for past scans cannot be recreated.
confirmAll.machineTelemetry: Deletes all {{count}} telemetry events. You will have no serial history to diagnose the next jam or disconnect with.
confirmAll.configHistory: Deletes all {{count}} config snapshots. Your current bin, module, and feeder settings keep working, but you will not be able to restore any earlier version of them.

retention.heading: Keep data for
retention.description: Anything older is deleted automatically. Reviewed scans are always kept.
retention.appliedAtLaunch: Applied when the app starts. Use Trim above to clean up right now.

machineEventDays.label: Machine telemetry
machineEventDays.hint: Serial log used to diagnose jams and disconnects

scanEventDays.label: Scan diagnostics
scanEventDays.hint: Scores and candidates from past identify attempts

acceptCaptureDays.label: Captures of accepted scans
acceptCaptureDays.hint: The photo only; the scan's numbers are kept

configAuditDays.label: Config history
configAuditDays.hint: Restore points for bin, module, and feeder settings
